# JoeDubs

> An esoteric archive exploring alternative cosmology, sacred geometry, and occult knowledge through concave earth theory and ancient philosophical traditions.

JoeDubs is a comprehensive digital library dedicated to natural philosophy and esoteric geometry. The site presents alternative cosmological models, historical research on concave earth theory, and archival collections of occult and metaphysical knowledge spanning ancient astronomy, Hermetic traditions, and cellular cosmogony.

## Key Topics

- Concave Earth Theory
- Cellular Cosmogony
- Sacred Geometry
- Alternative Cosmology
- Esoteric Knowledge
- Ancient Astronomy
- Hermetic Philosophy
- Greek Cosmology
- Occult Archives
- Earth Shape Analysis
- Metaphysical Sciences
- Librarium Esotericum
- Cosmic Egg Mythology
- Tamarack Mine Experiments
- Mysticism & Alchemy

## Core Archives & Products

- [JoeDubs – Natural Philosophy & Esoteric Geometry](https://joedubs.com): JoeDubs homepage featuring esoteric archives on sacred geometry & occult knowledge
- [Librarium Esotericum: An Archive of the Arcane](https://joedubs.com/librarium-esotericum-an-archive-of-the-arcane): Librarium Esotericum product page: archive of esoteric & occult knowledge

## Concave Earth Theory & Cosmology

- [Concave Earth](https://joedubs.com/concave-earth): Concave Earth theory overview with research resources & cosmological analysis
- [Is Earth Convex, Flat, or Concave?](https://joedubs.com/is-earth-convex-flat-or-concave): Analysis of earth shape theories comparing convex, flat & concave models
- [Cosmic Egg: Mythology Unveils the True Nature of Heaven & Earth](https://joedubs.com/cosmic-egg-mythology-unveils-the-true-nature-of-heaven-earth): Cosmic Egg mythology exploring ancient cosmology & concave earth theory
- [The Universe As It Really Is: Dolan Theory](https://joedubs.com/universe-as-it-really-is-dolan-theory): Dolan Theory analysis of concave earth & alternative cosmological models
- [The Lost Center](https://joedubs.com/the-lost-center): Cellular cosmology & concave earth theory challenging relativity framework
- [The World Inside Out by Oleg Shamansky](https://joedubs.com/the-world-inside-out-by-oleg-shamansky): Review of Shamansky's concave earth geometry & alternative cosmology work

## Historical Research & Evidence

- [High Altitude Observations of Earth](https://joedubs.com/high-altitude-observations-of-earth): Historical balloon aeronaut testimonies on earth shape observations
- [Tamarack Mine Experiments: Plumb-bobbing the Earth](https://joedubs.com/tamarack-mine-experiments-plumb-bobbing-the-earth): Historical Tamarack Mine plumb-bob experiments analyzing earth curvature
- [Maps of Our World: The Inverted Globe](https://joedubs.com/maps-of-our-world-the-inverted-globe): Historical cartography analysis & inverted globe maps challenging heliocentric model
- [Newspaper Articles on Heaven and Earth](https://joedubs.com/newspaper-articles-on-heaven-and-earth): Archival newspaper collection on Koreshanity & concave earth cosmology

## Ancient Philosophy & Astronomy

- [Spherical Heavens of Greek Cosmology](https://joedubs.com/spherical-heavens-of-greek-cosmology): Greek cosmology exploration via Parmenides, Ptolemy & ancient spherical models
- [Constellations as Seafaring Routes: The Stars are a Map of Earth](https://joedubs.com/constellations-as-seafaring-routes-the-stars-are-a-map-of-earth): Ancient astronomy analysis: constellations as seafaring route maps
- [Art of the Ancient World](https://joedubs.com/art-of-the-ancient-world): Renaissance & ancient artwork analysis depicting celestial spheres cosmology
